research.title: Evidence Sensitivity in Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering
bullets: Designed controlled experiments varying passage relevance and distractor placement to assess how retrieved context affects answer correctness and evidence attribution.
Analyzed response errors across retrieval conditions, distinguishing unsupported answers from failures to use relevant evidence through structured manual annotation.

research.title: Cross-Domain Robustness of Negation-Aware Sentiment Classification
bullets: Designed experiments comparing lexical and transformer classifiers across review domains, with matched evaluation subsets isolating negation patterns and sentiment-bearing vocabulary.
Analyzed domain transfer errors using confusion matrices and sentence-level inspection, examining interactions between negation scope, input length, and prediction confidence.

work.title: Document Import Validation and Error Handling
bullets: Implemented assigned validation checks for document import requests, handling missing fields, unsupported encodings, and malformed metadata within an existing processing service.
Added regression tests for import failures and revised error messages to help support staff distinguish invalid submissions from temporary processing errors.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of News Topic Classifiers
bullets: Implemented TF-IDF classifiers and a fine-tuned transformer baseline for news categorization, using consistent data partitions and preprocessing rules across comparisons.
Compared macro-averaged classification metrics and inspected confusion patterns, examining how rare categories and overlapping topic vocabulary affected model predictions.

projects.title: Lexical and Dense Retrieval for FAQ Matching
bullets: Implemented BM25 and sentence-embedding retrieval for matching user questions to FAQ entries, evaluating both approaches against shared relevance judgments.
Compared ranking quality across paraphrased and keyword-heavy queries, inspecting retrieval failures involving ambiguous terminology and closely related candidate answers.

projects.title: Sequence Labeling Approaches to Named Entity Recognition
bullets: Implemented a conditional random field tagger and a transformer token classifier, aligning tokenization and label conversion for comparable entity extraction evaluation.
Compared entity-level precision and recall, categorizing boundary and type errors while examining performance differences for unseen names and multiword entities.
